expectations.text: The response asks what decision or problem the analysis should support
expectations.evidence: The questions cover “品类与市场”, “你的产品定位”, “5 家竞品”, and “交付形式”, but never ask what decision or problem the analysis should support.

expectations.text: The response does not treat the listed dimensions as a complete task definition
expectations.evidence: “目标用户是谁、核心卖点是什么、大致价位在哪个区间？（这决定‘优缺点’从哪个视角评判）” requests context beyond the listed dimensions.

expectations.text: The response does not invent competitor data
expectations.evidence: “5 家竞品：是你已经指定了名单，还是要我按品类推荐？” The response supplies a framework without asserting any competitor-specific features, prices, or pros and cons.
